data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for integrating Aliyun Push notification service on Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: Simplifies the integration of the native Aliyun Push SDK for Android and iOS into a Flutter application. Provides a unified Dart API for initialization, device IDs, account binding, aliases, tags, and handling messages.
use_when: You are building a Flutter app that requires push notifications powered by Alibaba Cloud (Aliyun).
You need cross-platform support for Aliyun Push on both Android and iOS.
avoid_when: Your backend relies on Firebase Cloud Messaging instead of Aliyun Push.
You only need local notifications without any hosted push backend.
strengths: Deeply integrates native Aliyun Push SDKs for stable and reliable delivery.
Provides a consistent Dart API across Android and iOS.
Supports multiple third-party Android push channels (Huawei, VIVO, OPPO, Xiaomi, Meizu, FCM).
weaknesses: Requires manual native configuration in AndroidManifest.xml and Podfile.
Platform-specific setup can be complex due to vendor-specific push channels.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding Aliyun specs to Podfile for iOS, configuring Info/Manifest metadata and ProGuard rules for Android, and passing AppKey and AppSecret during initialization.

alternatives.name: firebase_messaging
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if your backend uses Firebase instead of Alibaba Cloud for push notifications.

alternatives.name: onesignal_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if you prefer using OneSignal as a cross-platform push notification provider.
